name: @zotoio/botz-mcp-swarm-cli
stderr:
Usage: botz-mcp-swarm [options] [command]

Standards-based MCP load testing — honest Pass/Fail, no silent green

Options:
  -V, --version       output the version number
  -h, --help          display help for command

Commands:
  run [options]       Execute a saved suite or test manifest
  soak [options]      Run a sustained suite or manifest test
  compare [options]   Compare two run reports for per-tool p95/error deltas
  record [options]    Record redacted MCP wire fixtures to file
  replay [options]    Replay a recorded fixture against a target
  discover [options]  Draft fixtures from allowlisted target (human approve
                      required)
  optimize [options]  LLM/heuristic description proposal with A/B bench (human
                      Accept required)
  approve [options]   Approve a discovery draft and emit a runnable manifest
  suite               Capture, inspect, refresh, and run standalone suites
  capture [options]   Introspect an MCP server and save a suite directory
  show [options]      Print a saved suite's target, enabled steps, and
                      parameters
  doctor [options]    Check local setup without contacting MCP or model servers
  project             Projects: introspected catalog, versioned suites, load
                      runs, and catalog-aware compare
  worker [options]    Run suites assigned by a swarm service. Long-running; does
                      not start the admin server
  help [command]      display help for command
